_doc: The ground cover (render/cover). Where it stands: sim/nature (paint and ecology). Sizes and looks are modelling choices compared by eye with the 4.0 (ports/landscape/reference-minha), no published value: spacing_m the lattice a kind's plants stand on, least the density under which nothing stands, size_m its width range, upright its height over its width, sink the share of its height under the ground, tint_vary the spread of its tone, road_margin_m kept clear of roads and lots, rough how much a lump's surface wanders, jitter and shade_bottom the tones of its faces (tree_parts.h). reach_m, fade_m, pop_m: as trees.placement in streets.json, shorter since a tuft is under a pixel past it. tuft_share: the share of the painted scrub and flowers that the grass stands up in. subdiv: how finely a lump is cut. flowers.blooms: the colours of the wildflowers, one variant each.
